newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady on selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady on selective trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Tuesday amid select buying of good quality stocks from spinners and dealers said rates were likely to remain steady or rise on sluggish arrivals.
"The pace of supply of fresh arrivals from the new (1997/98 July-June) crop has not picked up as expected," dealer Mustafa Hussain said.
He said spinners were buying good quality stocks as it would take a couple of weeks before the supply of new cotton picks up.
In the kerb, new crop NIAB-78 variety was traded at around 2,230 rupees ($54.89) per maund (37.32 k.g).
